name: privacy-shield
description: Redacts names, phones, Aadhaar, accounts and other personal data on this laptop before Antigravity sends anything to the model, and restores them in the answers.

commands.title: Privacy Shield: Show what was hidden (vault)
Privacy Shield: Show last request that left the laptop
Privacy Shield: Toggle peek mode (see what the model sees)
Privacy Shield: Forget this session's vault

privacyShield.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter with gliner installed. Empty = the bundled server/.venv created by 'Install Python environment'.

privacyShield.review.description: Ask in the chat before a table first leaves the laptop.

privacyShield.numbers.description: Also hide every run of this many digits or more (0 = off).

privacyShield.annotate.description: Append a one-line redaction summary under each answer.

privacyShield.relaunchArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments for the relaunched Antigravity (testing only).
